beatOutline.milestone: Mai feels frustrated and discouraged during an English listening exercise at the community center, finding it very hard to understand the words.
Mai talks to her kind English teacher, Mr. Long, about her difficulties and feelings. He advises her to practice daily and be patient with herself.
Mai starts practicing listening with simple English songs and stories. She also tries to 'listen' to the sounds of her local Đắk Lắk community, connecting it to her learning.
Mai faces another challenging listening task and almost gives up, but she remembers Mr. Long's advice and takes a deep breath to manage her frustration.

At a local community event, Mai successfully understands and responds to a simple English question from a visitor, feeling proud of her progress and realizing her emotional management helped her improve.
